notes: Residual decisions for the armor-set derivation (pipeline/merge/armor.ts, P2-S8). Everything else — set membership (the pieces a set article hosts), per-helmet set bonus game text, set-bonus effects, defense totals, stage and every single-class variant — is derived from Cargo Items, Module:Iteminfo/data, Cargo Equipinfo and the set article's infobox. Every quote is checked verbatim against the cached article revision.

withhold: the ArmorSet schema needs ≥1 helmet, ≥1 chest and exactly one legs piece hosted by the set article (none for a combination set ruled 'any legs'), and a set bonus per variant. Sets that cannot be expressed are not emitted; a gap entry records why and their pieces' setId is listed Unknown — never 'no set' (amendment candidates in the P2-S8 report).

P6 fix round (2026-10-15, additive schema: pieces.chests, optional pieces.legs, variants[].chestId): `chests` confirms, quoted, that any one of a set article's alternative chests completes the set (each chest named); when the Set Bonus segments name those chests the bonus is keyed by the chest (Beetle armor), one variant per helmet × chest. `combination` lists a set's members whose pieces live on their own articles (Wizard set) — checked row for row against the article's set-pieces table (name, item ID, body slot) and the emitted pieces — with `legs.quote` backing 'no legs piece'. `unrecorded` pieces are tied by the wiki to sets the schema cannot record (one setId per piece): their setId is listed Unknown with the quotes.

Loose-piece sweep (2026-10-15): every armor piece outside a recorded set was checked against its own article (the 12 not yet cached fetched through the pipeline client, serial, 1.1 s pacing — raw cache only, not build evidence): Viking Helmet states it 'does not have an associated set or set bonus'; Goggles, Empty Bucket (Buckets), Diving Helmet, Green Cap, Gi, Night Vision Helmet, Djinn's Curse, Moon Lord Legs, Dead Man's Sweater and Flinx Fur Coat state no set membership (the wiki's armor navbox files all but Green Cap under 'Single Pieces'); Ultrabright Helmet is interchangeable into Mining armor and Prospector armor (stated on all three articles) → `unrecorded`. Not modeled (pre-existing, reported): the Mining ⇄ Prospector piece interchangeability itself — each set records its own article's pieces only.

classes: ArmorSet.variants[].class is a single DamageClass. Where the variant's stats name several classes, the set article's own description decides: the wiki calls these sets hybrids ('melee/ranged', 'mage/summoner', …) or describes no class at all, so the ruling is 'other' = no single class — the safe direction for class-filtered recommendations (they are under-, never wrongly recommended).

AMENDMENTS-011 B52 (landed by the B70 P4-prep slice, 2026-10-14): a ruling's `classes` lists the hybrid's damage classes as its quoted article description names them ('mage' = magic, 'summoner' = summon); the build checks the quote names every listed class AND that the list equals the variant's stat class signals. Emitted as variants[].classes beside the kept single `class` (one release, consumers read classes ?? [class]). Crystal Assassin names no class, so it stays ['other'].
